result.summary: The page is mostly rendered correctly, but there is one clear visual defect: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the metadata line has two text fragments drawn on top of each other, making it unreadable. Other elements (carousels, chips, banner, bottom navigation) look as intended.

issues.description: On the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the metadata line below the restaurant name has overlapping text: the delivery time (e.g. '25–35 min') and the delivery fee (e.g. '€0 delivery') are rendered on top of each other, producing an illegible string like '25–3€0mdelivery' before the '• Ramen' item.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time and delivery fee as separate inline items in a row with proper spacing and separators (e.g. '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen'). Check for absolute positioning, negative margins or a missing flex gap on those metadata elements.
